crossRefs.keyword: Irnahash. or, the city of Nahash

people.name: Eshton
people.line: Son of Mehir; father of Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah.

people.name: Ir-nahash
people.line: A town associated with the descendants of Eshton

people.name: Paseah
people.line: Son of Eshton from the tribe of Judah

people.name: Tehinnah
people.line: Father of Ir-nahash from the tribe of Judah

translations.web: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.
translations.bsb: Eshton was the father of Beth-rapha, of Paseah, and of Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These were the men of Recah.
translations.kjv: And Eshton begat Bethrapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Irnahash. These are the men of Rechah.
translations.asv: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah.
